topic: First Memory entry focus and progression lock
currentUserGoal: Make the first Memory Grove visit clearly zoom in on Tiny Sprinkler, show only that required first Memory, and prevent stale or resumed saves from bypassing the intended Run 1 to Run 2 progression.
workCompleted: Found that the first-Memory presentation depended on an exact Run 1 collapse signature, so stale, resumed, or debug saves with Tiny Sprinkler still unowned could fall through to the full Memory Web.
Added a firstMemoryPending invariant for every inactive field where Tiny Sprinkler has not yet been remembered.
Blocked Begin Next Run whenever firstMemoryPending is true, regardless of the saved run number.
Restricted the visible Memory Web to Tiny Sprinkler while that first Memory remains pending.
Centered and selected Tiny Sprinkler automatically on entry.
Added a visible entry camera animation from 2.0x to 5.8x on desktop and 2.4x to 7.4x on phone.
Kept reloaded inactive saves at the final focused zoom so the first Memory remains immediately legible.
Added debug snapshot fields for firstMemoryPending, memoryTreeZoom, and selectedMemoryNodeId.
Added a regression test covering an inconsistent later-run save where Tiny Sprinkler is still unowned.
verificationRun: Focused EcosystemSystem, EcosystemMemoryTree, and EcosystemSave suites passed 38 tests.
npm run check passed: ESLint, 148 Vitest tests across 19 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
The local ecosystem prototype route responds on port 5173.

release.status: Verified local checkpoint; not pushed, merged into master, or promoted to production.

currentGitStatus: The intended first-Memory focus changes and this handoff are ready to commit on codex/ecosystem-factory-prototype.
docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains an unrelated untracked file and must stay untouched unless explicitly requested.
knownIssues: Final camera feel still needs the user's hands-on test after a fresh Run 1 collapse.

No external browser visual automation was used for final verification after an isolated headless Chrome launch failed; the temporary isolated profile was removed and the user's normal Chrome profile was never used.
A save that already owns Tiny Sprinkler correctly skips this first-Memory lock and shows the normal revealed Memory Web.
nextRecommendedSteps: Refresh the prototype and test a clean Run 1 collapse into Memory Grove.
Confirm that only Tiny Sprinkler is visible, the camera visibly closes in on it, and Begin Next Run remains unavailable until it is remembered.
After buying Tiny Sprinkler, confirm the existing reveal animation zooms back out to expose the next branches.
doNotRevert: Keep firstMemoryPending based on inactive state plus Tiny Sprinkler ownership rather than exact run-number metadata.
Do not allow Begin Next Run while Tiny Sprinkler remains unowned.
Do not touch docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
